finding.constraint: One useful native post or invitation per community; no repeated outreach.
finding.cause: The pre-send audit checked the exact mailbox and local matches for bro-agent but failed to consult The Colony's canonical target state and prior Ghostnode invitation at the community level.

remediation.passive_readback: Allowed only to document external effects and safety; not for conversion promotion.
remediation.future_preflight_rule: Every outbound candidate must pass both exact-recipient and fixed-community no-repeat checks against targets.json and durable evidence before send.
